description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL. Work runs for exactly two reasons: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening: "if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period."

FAMILIES 1-5 — DONE (e561842ce, 1ab96d652, d8fa56ed1, d9b5f0112, d332eadab): seed pushes deleted; scheduler demand-on-stall keystone; body.rs/dispatch.rs/contract.rs/types.rs push-free; arms for TypeDefined/GuardDispatch/ModuleDefined/FunctionDefined etc.

FAMILY 6 — DONE (folded 2026-07-03, three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS): jobs/semantic.rs converted — ~55 threading refs deleted through the whole analyze_activation helper chain (+ require_activation_key_facts' signature, root.rs's gated_follow_up deleted outright); 8 wait+push pairs -> bare waits; 2 new arms (FunctionContract->DeriveFunctionContract, CodeIndexed->IndexCode, both grep-verified sole-producer). Watch items RESOLVED: (a) the DefineModule(protocol) push deleted — audit PROVED the branch unreachable by construction (protocol_callback is populated only inside the same DefineModule run that co-publishes ProtocolDispatch with ModuleDefined; co-output facts get no arm by doctrine); (b) FunctionContract converted safely behind the function_declares_contract gate. REAL BUG FIXED: analyze_activation's first gate returned empty JobEffects when Activation(key) was absent (whole-job conclude-by-omission) — now wait_on_current, igniting SeedActivation via the drain expansion; producer_pokes on enum_take_drop_split dropped non-overlappingly (parent min 76 vs commit max 54 across widened sampling; healthy fixtures unchanged at 3, 0 stall events).

FAMILY 7 — THE ACTIVATION FRONTIER (next, the one kept push): analyze_activation's callee-discovery push (jobs/semantic.rs ~:233) is genuine frontier expansion, NOT an absence-gated pair — prepare_function_call deliberately only READS the callee's ReturnType (a wait would deadlock mutual recursion), so nothing ever blocks on the callee's analysis; removing the push fails 16 tests (audit-reproduced). The pull-shaped fix is the non-root analogue of family 3's demand_root_entry_analyses: a standing "activation frontier" demand structure in World — discovered activations (Activation facts published without a settled ActivationAnalyzed) become standing demands expanded by next_ready_job/the stall pass, exactly like roots. Then delete the push. The in-code comment at the site states the condition.

THE PUMP'S LAST RESIDUAL (fix with family 7 or separately): resolve_protocol_call's matches.is_empty() branch concludes a callsite with NO wait when ProtocolImplProviders(protocol) doesn't exist yet (the reads.push is has_fact-conditional — first pass drops the re-wake subscription). Fix needs a real wait on ProtocolImplProviders, which first needs settling whether that fact is once-and-done or monotone-growing (a wait on an ever-growing fact might never resolve). Once fixed, TIGHTEN THE PUMP: demand_producer_if_needed skips concluded producers outright, delete the TEMPORARY PUMP comment (drive.rs ~:181).

FAMILY 8+ (remaining, ref counts at family-6 fold): jobs/keying.rs 8; jobs/root.rs 5 (the wait_for_function_definition forward — world.rs family); quoted_expander.rs 4; jobs/source.rs 3; source_publish.rs 2; world.rs 1 (complete_job's effects.follow_up plumbing — dies at arc close with the JobEffects field).

TELEMETRY GAP: add an aggregate follow-up-emission counter before declaring the final family complete (pull-based.html's follow_ups=0 proof). demand_on_stall now carries demanded_facts metadata (fz-go4.18.30).

WATCH ITEMS: (1) coalesced-telemetry conflation (scheduler.rs) — split observability at arc close; (2) Scheduler::blocked/has_run pub-visibility sweep at arc close; (3) product wait loops lack a stall_demanded-style suppression memo (fix when fz-go4.19 dedups the loops).

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted; the pump tightened; scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only plus the submit_root ignition; docs updated (fact-engine.md legacy clause dropped; northstar.html tolerance clause updated). Sequencing: fz-go4.18.31 AFTER family 7 (both touch the analyze/wake paths).

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
